title: ISO 185:2020 — Grey cast irons — Classification
locator: Grey cast iron classification; confirmed current in 2025. Test properties may be characterized using cast samples, samples cut from castings by agreement, and/or hardness by agreement.
notes: 试样类别、取样位置/方向和供需约定影响结果；不把标准试棒数值无条件外推为大型床身各截面的性能保证。
